content:
watchOS 27 is the latest major software update for Apple Watch, bringing several new features and three brand-new apps to your wrist.

#1: Siri

Siri has received a major AI overhaul in watchOS 27, part of which includes a brand-new Siri app.

The Siri app is available for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Watch.

watchOS 27 still allows you to invoke Siri via the Digital Crown, but this app is another place where you can expand your conversations. More importantly, you can browse your past conversation history within the app.

The new Siri AI feels more like a real person than the old assistant, and will keep query history across all your devices. So the Siri app on watchOS 27 will not only show your Apple Watch conversations, but also history from your iPhone, Mac, and more.

#2: Find My

In line with the new features the Find My app is getting in iOS 27, Apple has also reimagined the Find My experience on watchOS this year.

In watchOS 26, Find My was split into three separate apps: Find Devices, Find Items, and Find Contacts.

But in watchOS 27, Apple has unified everything into a brand-new, all-in-one Find My app.

The Find My app on Apple Watch offers all the functionality of the previous three apps, but in a more streamlined experience, so you can easily find anything or anyone on the map-centric interface.

You can switch between different items to find via the menu in the top left corner, otherwise the interface remains largely the same.

#3: Readiness

If you own an Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4, watchOS 27 will also add a third app: Readiness.

Here's how the App Store describes the Readiness app's features:

"Readiness analyzes your recent activity, vitals, and sleep data to help you understand how you're doing each day. Features include: - Get a score and clear status category: Recovering, Taking it Easy, Ready to Go, or Beasting It - See explanations for contributing factors, with the ability to tap through to the relevant app - Add watch face complications and Smart Stack widgets for an at-a-glance view - View more on your iPhone in the Fitness app"

In short, Readiness gives you a quick overview of your overall vitals, so you can see how rested and ready your body is on a given day.

What do you think of the new Apple Watch apps in watchOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
